name: IOU

bboxes.description: First set of bounding boxes, shape (N, 4). Supports float32, float16.

gtboxes.description: Second set of bounding boxes (ground truth), shape (M, 4). Same dtype as bboxes.

mode.description: int, IoU computation mode: 0 = IoU (intersection over union), 1 = IoF (intersection over foreground area).

iou.description: IoU matrix of shape (N, M), same dtype as inputs.

reference:
import torch


def bbox_overlaps(bboxes1, bboxes2, mode='iou', aligned=False, offset=0):
    assert mode in ['iou', 'iof']
    if aligned:
        lt = torch.max(bboxes1[:, :2], bboxes2[:, :2])
        rb = torch.min(bboxes1[:, 2:], bboxes2[:, 2:])
        wh = (rb - lt + offset).clamp(min=0)
        overlap = wh[:, 0] * wh[:, 1]
        area1 = (bboxes1[:, 2] - bboxes1[:, 0] + offset) * (bboxes1[:, 3] - bboxes1[:, 1] + offset)
        if mode == 'iou':
            area2 = (bboxes2[:, 2] - bboxes2[:, 0] + offset) * (bboxes2[:, 3] - bboxes2[:, 1] + offset)
            ious = overlap / (area1 + area2 - overlap)
        else:
            ious = overlap / area1
    else:
        lt = torch.max(bboxes1[:, None, :2], bboxes2[:, :2])
        rb = torch.min(bboxes1[:, None, 2:], bboxes2[:, 2:])
        wh = (rb - lt + offset).clamp(min=0)
        overlap = wh[:, :, 0] * wh[:, :, 1]
        area1 = (bboxes1[:, 2] - bboxes1[:, 0] + offset) * (bboxes1[:, 3] - bboxes1[:, 1] + offset)
        if mode == 'iou':
            area2 = (bboxes2[:, 2] - bboxes2[:, 0] + offset) * (bboxes2[:, 3] - bboxes2[:, 1] + offset)
            ious = overlap / (area1[:, None] + area2 - overlap)
        else:
            ious = overlap / (area1[:, None])
    return ious


def run(bboxes, gtboxes, mode=0):
    b = bboxes.clone()
    b[:, 0], b[:, 2] = torch.minimum(bboxes[:, 0], bboxes[:, 2]), torch.maximum(bboxes[:, 0], bboxes[:, 2])
    b[:, 1], b[:, 3] = torch.minimum(bboxes[:, 1], bboxes[:, 3]), torch.maximum(bboxes[:, 1], bboxes[:, 3])
    g = gtboxes.clone()
    g[:, 0], g[:, 2] = torch.minimum(gtboxes[:, 0], gtboxes[:, 2]), torch.maximum(gtboxes[:, 0], gtboxes[:, 2])
    g[:, 1], g[:, 3] = torch.minimum(gtboxes[:, 1], gtboxes[:, 3]), torch.maximum(gtboxes[:, 1], gtboxes[:, 3])
    mode_str = 'iou' if mode == 0 else 'iof'
    return bbox_overlaps(b, g, mode=mode_str).t()
description:
IOU: Intersection over Union computation between bounding box sets.

Computes IoU (mode=0: intersection/union) or IoF (mode=1: intersection/foreground_area) between two sets of bounding boxes in (x1, y1, x2, y2) format.

Args:
    bboxes (Tensor): shape (N, 4), first set of bounding boxes.
    gtboxes (Tensor): shape (M, 4), second set of bounding boxes (ground truth).
    mode (int): 0 = IoU (intersection over union), 1 = IoF (intersection over foreground area).

Returns: Tensor of shape (N, M), same dtype as inputs.

---
NPU vendor API: torch_npu.npu_iou(bboxes, gtboxes, mode=mode) returns shape (N, M).
Also available via mmcv.ops.bbox_overlaps(bboxes, gtboxes, mode=mode).t().
